build_atari_wrapper: build an AtariWrapper instance wrapping a dm_env Atari environment with action repeats and frame stacking
create_base_atari_wrapper_subclass: create a subclass of BaseAtariWrapper that implements custom _preprocess_pixels for Atari frame processing
configure_action_repeats: configure an AtariWrapper with custom action_repeats, pooled_frames, and num_stacked_frames parameters
enable_zero_discount_on_life_loss: enable zero_discount_on_life_loss in AtariWrapper to set discount to zero when lives decrease
preprocess_atari_pixels: preprocess Atari frames using max pooling, grayscale conversion, and bilinear resizing to 84x84
